title: The gym's corner, inside its main doors
caption: For the clubs' winter meetings and the gym's two tickets (days 3 to 5). The gym's glass doors on the sports lane now open onto the south end of the hall, as far as the green divider net. It also loads with ?place=gym. Nobody is there yet.

sections.title: The doors
sections.caption: Before: the two pairs of glass doors carried 準備中 cards and were shut. After: the cards are gone and Go in takes Eric inside.

sections.title: Inside
sections.caption: The entrance's tiles with shoe lockers and a crate of indoor slippers; the attendant's desk with the booking terminal, an old desk fan, the booking sheets and the printer; the club board and an AED; the badminton court with its net up; two benches; the equipment store open on the ball carts; the winter meeting corner's folding chairs and whiteboard; the divider net, a goal and a clock beyond. On a desktop the whole corner is one frame; on a phone the camera follows Eric.
